workflow: Generate panorama first. Derive five independent layers from original layer geometry and new panorama lighting. Preserve exact original PNG bytes. Read-only dimensions/alpha measurements. No repository modifications.

tasks.prompt: Create exactly one production-quality environment asset for a layered side-view fighting game. Match the realistic, detailed volcanic Icelandic landscape and MULE camp design of the supplied references. The new dry variant has bright diffuse overcast daylight, dry matte compacted grey basalt gravel and slightly dusty mustard-yellow fabric; retain olive-green vegetation and the distant waterfall. Dry weather does not mean a desert or dead landscape. No snow, desert, sand dunes, rain, standing puddles, wet specular reflections, people, creatures, text, logos, interface, labels, borders, collage, contact sheet or invented large props. Preserve composition and recognizable silhouettes. Keep the center of the fighting lane readable. Edit this existing panorama into its DRY-WEATHER counterpart. Requested native aspect ratio 16:9, full-frame opaque. Keep this exact camera and layout: massive stepped mossy basalt cliffs along the left, open valley and waterfall center-right, mustard-yellow and khaki tents on the left, grey/yellow cargo cases in their existing positions, and the illuminated tall cross-arm camp beacon at far right. Preserve each object's relative scale, position, the horizon and wide open level foreground lane. Change the weather and material state only: a luminous pale silver-grey overcast sky with soft warm light from upper left; no dark storm mood. Replace EVERY puddle and reflective muddy patch across the foreground with firm dry compacted grey volcanic gravel, fine muted brown-grey dust, subtle compressed tire marks and small matte stones. The walking plane stays wide and uninterrupted. Tent fabric becomes matte dry worn canvas, slightly dusty, without glossy wet streaks. Do not move the tents, beacon, crates, cliffs or waterfall. Keep the valley green; the waterfall naturally remains water. Cinematic realistic game environment, crisp material detail, coherent soft diffuse shadows, no transparency.
